description: The shipped catalogue of focus areas. A focus area is a named set of terms. regwatch ranks candidates that mention one of the terms ahead of candidates that mention none. Copy this file, edit it, and point [profile] catalogue at the copy to change the areas or their terms.

focus_areas.label: Non-alcoholic beverages
focus_areas.description: Soft drinks, juices, waters, teas, coffees and other drinks sold without alcohol.

focus_areas.label: Alcoholic beverages
focus_areas.description: Beer, wine, spirits, ciders and other drinks that contain alcohol.

focus_areas.label: Cannabis and hemp products
focus_areas.description: Cannabis, hemp and cannabinoid products, including edibles, oils and topicals.

focus_areas.label: Traditional foods
focus_areas.description: Heritage, artisanal, regional and culturally specific foods, including fermented and cured products.

focus_areas.label: Dietary supplements
focus_areas.description: Vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics and other products sold as supplements.

focus_areas.label: Infant food
focus_areas.description: Infant formula, baby food and nutrition products for infants and young children.

focus_areas.label: Pet food
focus_areas.description: Food, treats and supplements for companion animals, and the feed ingredients used in them.

focus_areas.label: Cosmetics
focus_areas.description: Cosmetics and personal care products, including their ingredients and labeling.
